Impacted Systems: All Windows versions from Windows 7 to Windows 10 latest
Method of Attack: NTLM relay attack allowing attackers to trigger authenticated RPC/DCOM calls and relay NTLM authentication to other protocols to elevate privileges to domain administrator
Launching special-purpose applications in the session of other logged-in users to send NTLM hashes to attacker-controlled IP addresses
Crafting requests to domain controller pretending to be domain administrator using intercepted NTLM hashes
Attack Vector: NTLM relay attack exploiting authenticated RPC/DCOM calls
Relaying NTLM authentication to other protocols
Exploitation of multiple logged-in user sessions on Windows Server systems
Indicators of Compromise: Intercepted NTLM hashes from domain administrators
Use of special-purpose applications sending NTLM hashes to attacker IP
